put.description: Upserts the authenticated user's display name and marketing email preference. Lazy-creates the `user_config` row when missing. `display_name` is trimmed; empty or whitespace-only values are rejected. When `marketing_emails_opt_in` becomes `true`, sets `marketing_emails_opt_in_at` to now if newly opted in; when set to `false`, clears `marketing_emails_opt_in_at` to null. Pass `terms_of_service_agreed_at: "now"` to record Terms of Service agreement at the server's current time (preserved once set; not overwritten). `user_id`, timestamps, and client-supplied ISO values for `marketing_emails_opt_in_at` / `terms_of_service_agreed_at` may be included when echoing a prior GET but are ignored — ownership and timestamps are server-controlled.

display_name.description: How the user appears to themselves and others. Trimmed server-side; must be non-empty after trim. Max length 80.

marketing_emails_opt_in.description: Explicit consent for product/marketing email. When flipped to true, `marketing_emails_opt_in_at` is set; when flipped to false, that timestamp is cleared.

terms_of_service_agreed_at.description: Pass the literal string `now` to record Terms of Service agreement using the server clock. Any other value (including ISO timestamps from a prior GET, or null) is ignored. Once recorded, the agreement timestamp is not cleared or overwritten.

200.description: User config updated (or created then updated).

user_config.description: Owner-only preferences for the signed-in user after upsert.

400.description: `display_name` is empty or whitespace-only after trim.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

user-config.description: Product-owned preferences for the signed-in user (owner-only). Keyed by Kratos identity id. Holds display name, marketing email consent, and Terms of Service agreement — not auth traits. Kratos owns identity/credentials/sessions; this resource is the Kratos-minimal product DB pattern.

user_id.description: Kratos identity id of the owning user.

display_name.description: How the user appears to themselves and to others. May be empty after lazy-create until the first save; PUT requires a non-empty trimmed value.

marketing_emails_opt_in.description: Explicit consent for product/marketing email. Defaults to false until the user opts in.

marketing_emails_opt_in_at.description: When the user most recently opted into marketing email. Null when never opted in or after opting out (cleared when `marketing_emails_opt_in` becomes false).

terms_of_service_agreed_at.description: When the user agreed to the Terms of Service. Null until agreement is recorded (typically via PUT with `terms_of_service_agreed_at: "now"`). Once set, later preference updates do not clear or overwrite it.

created_at.description: When the user config row was created.

updated_at.description: When the user config row was last updated.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
